title: "Motus Array Maintenance"

::: {.callout style="border-left: 6px solid #D99B8F; --bs-callout-border: #D99B8F; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 1rem;"}
Since 2021, our local automated Motus array is sitting both in the **Hunter** estuary and **Port Stephens** estuary, with **eight** and **three** stations respectively.

This page displays a dynamic map where you can explore for each station its history.

You can also openly explore location and a few other aspects on [Motus server](https://motus.org/dashboard/#e=profile&d=projects&s=294&f=%7B%7D&t=stationsDeployed).

A Motus station is made of multiple components:

-   **Antenna** (either directional or omni-directional), to detect any VHF signal

-   **SensorGnome Receiver**, to identify a VHF signal from a known or unknown tag, to transform it into detection data before to store it onboard

-   **Solar panel + battery** (low cycle 12V), to provide electrical power

-   **Mast & shelf**, to provide a supporting structure

Note that you can build any station yourself by simply following the [installation guide](https://docs.motus.org/en/stations/station-installation) freely delivered by Motus.
:::

Below is shown the last 20 detections from the complete array (including noise and test tags), the data is raw and unfiltered.  
  
::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Click to view the raw detection data"}
```{r Tables rawdata}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| 
library(motus)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(forcats) 
library(lubridate)
library(bioRad) 
library(purrr) 


sql.motus <- tagme(
  projRecv = 294,
  new = FALSE,
  update = FALSE,
  dir = here::here("qmd", "chapter_1", "data"))

df.alltags <- tbl(sql.motus, "alltags") %>%
  dplyr::collect() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(time = as_datetime(ts),
         timeAus = as_datetime(ts, tz = "Australia/Sydney"),
         dateAus = as_date(timeAus),
         year = year(time), 
         doy = yday(time)) 

df.alltags <- df.alltags %>%
  select(recvDeployName, recv, tagModel, pulseLen, motusTagID, timeAus, speciesEN) %>%
  arrange(recvDeployName, timeAus) %>%
  group_by(recvDeployName) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(recvDeployName)) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      order = list(list(0, 'asc'))),
    filter = "top",
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = "Last 20 detections (raw data) per Motus station")

df.alltags

```
:::
